title: Follow-up: pyright call-hierarchy numbers on click 7.1.2 under the committed ground truth (informational, not 0.1.0)
description: DEC-303 (a17) item 3: pyright on click is NOT part of S8; it is held here, informational only, and does not block 0.1.0. It runs only after the glyph gate result (GCLI-83) is committed. The baseline comparison (a1) item 5 and (a2) ruling 2 require is the requests one, which already exists. Needs the three derived inputs for the click harness (symbols.json, allcalls.json and the 133 click targets with a column joined from symbols.json by file, line and qualname, via test/python-lsp-measurement/gt1_enumerate.py on src/click at 1784558ed7c75c65764d2a434bd9cbb206ca939d), committed under test/python-lsp-measurement/ with a README line; pyright 1.1.414 with the registry integrity recorded in that README. No ground-truth change.

acceptanceCriteria.text: pyright 1.1.414 is run over click 7.1.2 with the committed harness and the click ground truth, after GCLI-83 is committed, with versions and input hashes recorded and the numbers reported beside glyph as informational
